notes: The capability covers both descriptors, maskedmin and maskedmax, from one kernel module (video-maskedminmax.ts).

[FS-OPTS]: vf_maskedminmax.c defines no framesync options (its AVClass holds only planes), so native rejects shortest, eof_action, repeatlast and ts_sync_mode with Option not found (status 8). They are refused here as unknown options instead of accepting shortest; the join step always carries shortest:false, which gives native's sync=1/EXT_STOP/EXT_INFINITY semantics on every input.

tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts always runs the linear path, which a join cannot take, so the per-source negotiation test is implemented inside the differential file on the four join paths following the helper's method; the helper was not edited.
Native opens its output file before config_output fails on size mismatches; EdgeFFmpeg refuses in geometry() before opening any output.
Mutation checks: <=/>= tie handling failed 4 differential tests, ignoring the plane mask failed 4, swapping min and max failed 5.

The sandbox reference (ac302e4d...) differs from the linux-x64 pin in compat/reference-pins.json (5e43da9ad1ee, built with Debian gcc 12.2.0); it was accepted with --allow-unpinned-reference and checked only for commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm.
Integer-only kernel: no platform gating; the differential file runs in about 10 s on this sandbox.

Registry test examples: split=3[a][b][c];[a][b][c]maskedmin, a flipped planes=1 variant, split=3[a][b][c];[a][b][c]maskedmax and a transposed planes=0 variant; all pass on graph, stream, actor and timed from the 8x8 gray source.
